message.content:
Looking at the luminance timeline, the film is entirely monochrome and dominated by a long stretch of dark/mid‑gray footage punctuated by many thin, bright vertical highlights. That pattern—broadly varied, brighter early material giving way to an extended, regular "comb" of bright streaks against a dark ground—is characteristic of the high‑contrast industrial lighting of the underground machine hall and the futuristic city sequences, i.e. **Metropolis**.

Answer: J
